newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINANCIAL SUPERVISION REQUEST POLICE PROBE OF AMER.
newsitem.headline: FINANCIAL SUPERVISION REQUEST POLICE PROBE OF AMER.

text.p: The Financial Supervision said on Friday it had asked the police to investigate whether Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy neglected to supply information about a decline in profits in early 1996.

"The Financial Supervision has asked the Helsinki police to investigate, whether the board of directors of Amer-yhtyma has possibly neglected its reporting obligation under the securities trading act," the Financial Supervision said in a statement.
In September, the Helsinki Stock Exchange's disciplinary committee fined Amer 100,000 markka for being slow to report changes in the company's earnings.
